name: Loan Calculator
author: Mikhail Kostikov

sections.description:
Loan Calculator is a powerful WordPress plugin that provides an interactive loan calculator with application management system. Built with Vue.js for smooth user experience.

Key Features:
* Interactive slider-based loan amount selection
* Customizable loan terms and interest rates
* Real-time monthly payment calculations
* Built-in loan application form
* Admin panel for application management
* Customizable currency and phone number format
* Multi-language support
* Email notifications for new applications

Technical Features:
* Vue.js 3 frontend
* Custom post type for loan applications
* AJAX form submission
* Responsive design
* Configurable preset amounts
* Input validation and formatting
* Terms and conditions links support
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/loan-calculator directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Settings -> Loan Calculator to configure parameters
  4. Use shortcode [loan_calculator] to display the calculator on any page
sections.faq:
How do I display the calculator?

Use the shortcode [loan_calculator] on any page or post.

Can I customize the currency symbol?

Yes, you can change the currency symbol in the plugin settings.

Is it possible to change the loan amount presets?

Yes, you can set custom preset amounts in the plugin settings.
